== English Decipher comparison ==
The Glossary broadens the basic piloting bonus. The Independent starship or Jabba condition for the larger bonus remains. Both versions retain the Tatooine deployment restriction and battle defense bonus. Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=141 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 141. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=5 Decipher Errata], PDF page 5. Players Committee, 2023, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=134 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A], PDF page 134.
